actions.banHint: The user can no longer sign in, and nodes drop the user on their next sync.
actions.resetSecretHint: UUID and subscription token are regenerated; the user must re-import the subscription.
actions.resetTrafficHint: Upload and download usage go back to zero.
actions.deleteHint: Their orders, tickets and traffic records are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

loginAs.title: Log in as {name}
loginAs.hint: This is a one-time login link. Opening it in this browser replaces your current admin session — copy it into a private window or another browser instead.

fields.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep it; at least 8 characters
fields.expiredAtHint: Local time; clear it for no expiry
fields.followSystemHint: Leave empty to use the system setting
fields.discountHint: Percent off every order; empty for none
fields.isStaffHint: Handles tickets, notices and the knowledge base

create.title: New user
create.planHint: Choosing a plan fills in its group and traffic

generate.title: Generate users
generate.prefixHint: Addresses are prefix + random string @ suffix
generate.suffixError: Enter a domain such as example.com
generate.passwordHint: Leave empty to give every user a random password
generate.doneHint: The CSV download has started; use the button below if it did not. It contains passwords — keep it safe.

mail.title: Send mail
mail.recipients: Goes to the {count} users matching the current filters
mail.recipientsUnknown: Goes to the users matching the current filters
mail.allUsers: No filters set: every user receives it
mail.subject: Subject
mail.contentHint: Markdown; the mail queue sends it in the background

subscription.accessHint: Clients that recently fetched this user's subscription (full IP addresses).
subscription.unavailable: The server does not provide an access log.
subscription.resetAgeHint: Generates a new age key pair for this user (the encryption switch is kept); the old private key stops working and the user has to read the new one in the user center and update their clients.
subscription.ageReset: New age key generated for this user
subscription.rotateHint: There is no separate admin token rotation endpoint, so this is the same as Reset subscription secret: the UUID and token are both replaced, the user must import again and their sessions end.
subscription.rotateNote: Rotating from the admin console also resets the UUID (it uses Reset subscription secret).
subscription.ageNone: This user has no age key.
